items.question: The gradient of the line y = 3x + 2 is?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 3. Solve the simultaneous equations: 2x + y = 10 and x - y = 2 (4 marks)
4. Find the equation of the line through (2, 3) with gradient 4. (3 marks)
5. Use the triangle in the diagram to find the value of sin A and cos A. (4 marks)
6. A car is bought for Ksh 800,000 and depreciates at 15% per year. Find its value after 2 years. (4 marks)
7. Given that the radius of the circle in the diagram is 14 cm, find the area of the shaded sector of 90 degrees. (4 marks)
9. The mean of five numbers is 12. Four of them are 10, 14, 11 and 9. Find the fifth number. (3 marks)
